scripts.deploy: bash -c 'set -Eeuo pipefail; UV_VERSION=0.13.8; UV_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin"; UV_BIN="$UV_DIR/uv"; if [ ! -x "$UV_BIN" ] || [ "$("$UV_BIN" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "uv $UV_VERSION" ]; then mkdir -p "$UV_DIR"; curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "https://astral.sh/uv/$UV_VERSION/install.sh" | env UV_INSTALL_DIR="$UV_DIR" UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh; fi; "$UV_BIN" --version; exec "$UV_BIN" run --group dev pywrangler deploy'
